datasets.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Airports (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['aeroway'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['building'] = 'aerodrome' OR tags['emergency:helipad'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['emergency'] = 'landing_site' Features may have these attributes: name name:en aeroway building emergency emergency:helipad operator:type capacity:persons addr:full addr:city source name:bs name:hr name:sr This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_bih_airports]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Airport and aerodrome infrastructure features were extracted from OpenStreetMap using aeroway tags, building=aerodrome classification, and emergency helipad/landing_site designations. Data was compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) and exported in multiple vector formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) with attributes including facility names, operator type, and capacity information.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.description: Volunteered geographic information (VGI) providing spatial inventory of aeroway features, buildings classified as aerodromes, emergency helipads, and landing sites across Bosnia and Herzegovina
